resolution.summary: Opt-in read-only pinned E5 prototype, heading-aware documents and source-freshness guard implemented. All18 preregistered fresh agent trials retained and causal-replayed: each arm48/48 functional36/36 memory, no observed quality gain, higher E5 time/input under mandatory dual reads. Failed/passing preflights preserved. Post-collection cache-only correction independently verified with actual model; frozen original worker archived and benchmark not rerun. Configured checks passed; broader independent real-project, identity/training and service hardening work remains backlog.
